articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
articles.snippet: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

articles.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
articles.snippet: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

articles.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
articles.snippet: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
articles.snippet: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.

articles.title: The crypto wallet that grew up inside Telegram is striking out on its own
articles.snippet: The app will offer crypto trading, tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, and perpetual futures, all already available through Telegram.
